result.title: Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Reinforcement-learning agents shape the observations they encounter; consequently, detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) states requires analysing action-conditioned trajectories rather than treating inputs as independent samples. We propose Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility (ACTI), a detector that evaluates forward and backward transition likelihoods, calibrates this comparison against the in-distribution profile at each timestep, and smooths the score over a short window, using no future information. We tested ACTI across six environments and fifteen detectors within OOD-RL-Bench, using the four anomaly mechanisms that qualified in every environment, with ten policy replicates per environment. All primary metrics are matched-time: each score after anomaly onset is compared with a clean twin rollout's score at the same timestep. Our method secured the top macro matched-time AUROC, outperforming the dynamics-model baseline (PEDM), while scoring transitions roughly two orders of magnitude faster. Compared to the state-only variant, ACTI achieved a small but consistent AUROC gain and a shorter detection delay. The capacity-matched forward-only baseline, ACTI-Forward, secured a statistically significant advantage in AUPRC alongside a reduced detection delay. The discrepancy in AUROC did not reach statistical significance. Ablation studies suggest instead that performance improvements stem from action conditioning, calibration at each timestep, and smoothing of the transition-likelihood scores. Based on these results, we recommend using ACTI-Forward.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ACTI 检测器，用前向与后向转移似然之比、按时间步对照分布内画像校准并做短窗平滑，在 OOD-RL-Bench 六个环境中做 OOD 状态检测，并与 PEDM 等基线比较，最终推荐更快的 forward-only 版本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「前向/后向转移似然差＋逐步校准＋窗口平滑」的在线序列打分，可能可迁移为 latent 推理轨迹的可靠性或异常信号乃至停止判据，其不使用未来信息的设定可供核查。
